docs.title: 主页
docs.text:
学习 · 创作 · 设计

欢迎来到我的网站！

我在这里记录学习、打磨项目，也把零散的想法整理成清晰的作品。网站保持简洁，把注意力留给真正有价值的内容。

查看项目 阅读笔记 作品集系统 从内容到作品，形成长期可更新的个人空间。

网站的方向

少一点堆砌，多一点判断。

我希望这个网站像一个安静但有秩序的工作台：课程笔记用来沉淀知识，项目页面用来展示实践，关于页面用来说明我是谁、我正在靠近什么。

01 课程笔记

把学习过程整理成可复用的知识卡片，而不是只留下零散收藏。

02 项目作品

像展示产品一样展示项目：主角明确，价值清楚，过程可追溯。

03 关于我

持续更新我的方向、能力边界和正在形成的个人风格。

docs.title: 课程
docs.text: 这里不只是放“学过什么”，而是把学习过程整理成可以再次使用的知识系统。每篇文章都围绕一个清晰问题展开：它解决什么、怎么实践、最后留下什么判断。

docs.title: 写作原则
docs.text:
• 标题要具体，不写空泛的大词
  • 开头先说明这篇文章解决的问题
  • 中间写步骤，也写为什么这样做
  • 结尾留下可复用的结论

docs.title: Home
docs.text:
Learning · Building · Designing

Welcome to my website.

I use this space to document learning, refine projects, and turn scattered ideas into clear, visible work. The site stays simple so the content can carry the weight.

View Projects Read Notes Portfolio system Turning content into work and building a personal space that can keep growing.

Direction

Less clutter. More judgment.

I want this site to feel like a quiet, organized workbench: notes for learning, projects for practice, and an about page for the person and direction behind the work.

01 Notes

Turning learning into reusable knowledge rather than leaving it as scattered bookmarks.

02 Projects

Presenting projects like products: with a clear subject, visible value, and traceable process.

03 About

Keeping track of my direction, current skills, and developing personal style.

docs.title: Notes
docs.text: This section is not just a list of things I have learned. It is a growing knowledge system that makes learning reusable. Each note should answer a clear question: what problem it solves, how to practice it, and what judgment remains afterward.

docs.title: Writing Principles
docs.text:
• Make the title specific
  • State the problem at the beginning
  • Write the steps and explain why they matter
  • End with reusable conclusions
